evidence.method: Versioned forecast snapshot requested for 12 route-tied nodes with hourly temperature, precipitation, snowfall, wind speed, wind gust and wind direction.
limitations: Modelled forecast context, not an in-situ station observation.
The generic forecast response does not expose a single model-run timestamp; retrievedAt records snapshot retrieval time.
Weather values do not imply road condition, transitability, authorization or operational safety.
Environment nodes are route-tied analytical samples interpolated from versioned corridor geometry and elevation assets.
